title: Returning pleasure in today’s fitting measure

captions.energy: Restoring pleasure only in complete form
captions.emotions: Feeling calm agreement within available measure

meaning: Today’s measure supports leisure when renewing meaningful pleasure permits a simple form without restoring the whole earlier experience completely.
text: Meaningful leisure can return on a smaller scale. Judgement in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes responding to a wish to renew pleasant shared experience. The World in energy leans towards restoring it only in complete form. Temperance in emotions brings calm agreement within an available measure. Both may want familiar enjoyment without a long programme. Yet remembering former fullness can make a modest version seem insufficient. Today’s readiness disappears among conditions although the living wish sought company again, beyond an exact copy of every part of an earlier evening.

For example, you remember walks looking at attractive doors together. A short outing appeals today while the earlier route was much longer. **Renewed pleasure can fit today’s comfortable measure.** You can choose the nearest stretch and calmly share a few discoveries. Both need no complete old route for returning to be real. A small outing makes room for conversation and freely deciding whether what you saw suffices or continuation appeals.

The difficulty is measuring today against the largest former form. You add turns for completeness and stop hearing a quiet wish to finish. Returning becomes a test of quantity. A jointly chosen measure preserves enjoyment without exact reproduction. Both can value the earlier route and finish this one sooner. Familiar meaning stays alive while future continuation remains free instead of obliging the whole past experience to be restored to its end.
